headlines.title: Seagate (STX) Unveiled FireCuda Forge With Its New Alkemi Storage Platform
headlines.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings (NasdaqGS: STX) introduced the FireCuda Forge drive, built on its new Alkemi intelligent storage platform. The FireCuda Forge is designed to pair SSD like responsiveness with HDD style capacity for consumers and content creators. The launch shifts Seagate’s recent focus from earnings and guidance updates toward a new product aimed at high performance storage use cases.

headlines.summary: Kratos CEO Eric DeMarco said the partnership would give defense customers an additional option for critical launch and testing missions, with offshore platforms providing greater operational flexibility.

headlines.title: Capital Group Div Value (CGDV) Buys $69.5 Million More FTAI Aviation on Nov. 6
headlines.summary: The fund bought $69.5 million of FTAI Aviation and $65.7 million of Meta Platforms, while selling $18.5 million of Exxon Mobil.

headlines.title: Seagate Launches the FireCuda Forge, Powered by New Alkemi Intelligent Platform to Deliver Both SSD-Grade Responsiveness and HDD Capacity
headlines.summary: SINGAPORE, November 10, 2026--Seagate launches FireCuda Forge, powered by Alkemi dynamic caching technology, delivering SSD responsiveness and HDD capacity for gamers and creators.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
